title: A solution to Frankl and Kupavskii's conjecture concerning Erdős-Kleitman matching problem
summary: For integers $n\ge s\ge2$, let $e(n,s)$ be the maximum size of a family $\mathcal F\subseteq2^{[n]}$ with no $s$ pairwise disjoint members. The study of determining $e(n,s)$ is closely related to its uniform counterpart, the well-known Erdős matching conjecture. Frankl and Kupavskii conjectured an exact formula for $e((m+1)s-\ell,s)$ when $1\le \ell\le \lceil s/2\rceil$.
